name: Signature Pool Villa
shortDescription: A private villa with plunge pool, shaded terrace, sculptural bath, and discreet butler service.
description: The Signature Pool Villa is a serene indoor-outdoor sanctuary crafted for privacy. Expect layered textures, a private plunge pool, a garden dining terrace, linen-draped king bedroom, sculptural soaking bath, walk-in wardrobe, and personalized arrival amenities.

name: Royal Terrace Suite
shortDescription: A luminous suite with panoramic terrace, separate salon, marble bath, and curated art.
description: The Royal Terrace Suite places dramatic views at the center of the experience, with a generous living salon, breakfast terrace, king bedroom, marble bath, writing desk, cocktail cabinet, and artwork selected from regional studios.

reviews.name: Jonas
reviews.text: The terrace became our favorite room.

name: Presidential Residence
shortDescription: A landmark residence with private pool, cinema lounge, chef kitchen, and hosted dining pavilion.
description: The Presidential Residence is created for extended stays, landmark celebrations, and guests who want uncompromising privacy. It includes a principal bedroom, guest bedroom, cinema lounge, dining pavilion, chef kitchen, garden pool, and dedicated residential host.

name: Garden Sanctuary
shortDescription: A calm hideaway overlooking fragrant gardens with a reading alcove and deep soaking bath.
description: This garden-facing sanctuary is designed for slow mornings and restorative evenings. Sliding screens open onto a planted veranda while warm stone, woven textures, and soft lighting create a private retreat.

name: Ocean Celeste Suite
shortDescription: A sweeping ocean-view suite with floating daybed, dining terrace, and sunken lounge.
description: The Ocean Celeste Suite is a dramatic horizon-facing retreat with a sunken lounge, floating terrace daybed, generous bath, and an intimate dining area arranged for sunrise breakfast or moonlit service.
